influences.name: Carole King
influences.context: My first records were Carole King and James Taylor, and they felt like lifelines for me.

influences.name: James Taylor
influences.context: My first records were Carole King and James Taylor, and they felt like lifelines for me. Tapestry and Mud Slide Slim and the Blue Horizon.

influences.name: Don Henley
influences.context: That was when Don Henley said, 'You need to quit giving your songs away. And if you're serious about this, you need to hold on to your songs for yourself.'

influences.name: Carly Simon
influences.context: It's sort of like my version of Carly Simon's 'You're So Vain.'
